**Plan, no edits made.**

`buildRows()` in [report.js](src/report.js) already carries every field, `owner` and `slow` included. `toTable()` in [format.js](src/format.js) drops those two on purpose for width.

1. In `cli.js`, parse `--json` out of argv.
2. If set, `JSON.stringify(buildRows(), null, 2)` instead of `toTable`.
3. Skip `format.js` entirely, since JSON wants the full row, not the table's trimmed columns.

Next: say go and I'll make the edit.
